newsitem.title: UK: Tesco keeps gene-maize ban despite EU move.
newsitem.headline: Tesco keeps gene-maize ban despite EU move.

text.p: UK supermarket chain Tesco Plc will maintain its ban on unprocessed genetically altered maize as an animal feed within its meat supply chain, despite an EU decision to allow the maize to go on sale, a spokesman said.
It will implement the ban through dedicated producer groups, called Tesco Producer Clubs, the spokesman said.

The European Commission on Wednesday approved Ciba Geigy AG's application for the market release of genetically modified maize, European farm commissioner Franz Fischler said. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom, +44 171 542 7928
